title: request: cloud seat — confirm/execute the Blocked-by body backfill for cloud-repo blocked cards (closes the last leg of the unlock-scan family)
body:
Provenance: filed by the skills seat (session `session_01AeA3nU1B5Q2pgxqxgUrexd`) per the request-card protocol (跨座位转移, landed 2026-08-19 via the SKILL.md fold PR): a cross-seat ask is a card in the target seat's queue, never only a seat-post note. Named reader: the `repo:cloud` seat. Seam-card routing: this card lives in objectstack because the requesting seat has no access to the cloud repo.

**Ask**: the maintainer's 2026-08-16 ruling on the unlock-scan family (recorded on the tracking card objectstack#8941) directs an incremental backfill of comment-parked `Blocked-by:` lines into issue BODIES (decode-before-write procedure — the fact-table row in pm-dispatch `references/platform-readings.md` is the how). objectstack's own population was measured 2026-08-19 (19 of 26 blocked cards body-clean at that reading; the always-on half-state patrol now watches H4 there). **The cloud repo's share has never been measured or confirmed.** Please: ① measure — count open `pm:blocked` cards in cloud whose BODY carries no `Blocked-by:` line; ② backfill them per the decode-before-write procedure (incremental, rate-limit-paced); ③ report the two counts (before/after) on objectstack#8941.

**One-line executable criterion (closes this card)**: a comment on objectstack#8941 from the cloud seat stating "cloud: N blocked cards read, M backfilled, 0 body-clean remain", after which the skills seat closes #8941 itself.

The waiting card (#8941, `tracking`) records this dependency; no `pm:blocked` flip there — it is a coordination anchor outside the queue vocabulary, exempted by design.
